current_events: The Royal Saudi Air Force strikes a fuel depot near Sanaa, Yemen. The Houthis launch missiles upon multiple Saudi Arabian cities, including Riyadh and Dammam, in response
An administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, is partially consumed by a fire after a Houthi missile is intercepted over the city by Saudi forces

Hezbollah spokesperson Ali Damoush announces they will pay up to US$14,000 in aid to families whose homes in Lebanon were destroyed or made uninhabitable during its war with Israel. Families in Beirut and its suburbs will receive $14,000, while the rest of Lebanon will receive $12,000

Two merchant ships are hit by unknown drones off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast, with one sinking. Eleven crew members are missing and 20 in total are rescued. Bulgarian prime minister Rumen Radev has blamed Russia and summoned its ambassador. It is the second such attack in six days
Bulgaria–Russia relations, Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Six deaths are confirmed in Florida, United States, from Hurricane Isaias
2026 Atlantic hurricane season
At least seven people are killed and over 40 others are injured in a train derailment near Multan, Punjab, Pakistan
The World Health Organization reports a surge in cholera cases in Yemen over the past three weeks
Indonesian authorities release 20 protected green sea turtles back into the oceans off Bali after they were seized from an empty boat abandoned by wildlife smugglers last week

Cornell University in Ithaca, New York, United States, suspends all fraternity parties and social events for the remainder of the 2026–27 academic year following allegations that seven Chi Phi members drugged and gang-raped a student in 2024
2024 Cornell University rape allegations

Philippine prosecutors in the impeachment trial of vice president Sara Duterte drop three of the four impeachment charges in an attempt to speed up the trial. The Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, approves the move
Impeachment trial of Sara Duterte

The Hungarian National Assembly passes an amendment repealing most provisions of the anti-LGBTQ child protection law that was previously passed during former prime minister Viktor Orbán's tenure in 2021

The Clark County District Court in Nevada, United States, sentences former Crips gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis to a minimum of 40 years in prison for orchestrating the 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas
Four people are killed and three more injured in a mass shooting at a memorial service in Katlehong, Gauteng, South Africa
Eight people are injured in a mass stabbing at a supermarket in Incheon, South Korea. A suspect is arrested
Students in Tirana, Albania, throw bricks at the Ministry of Education building, prompting riot police to respond

The Netherlands denies visas to Russian artistic gymnasts Anna Kalmykova, Viktoria Listunova, and Angelina Melnikova for the world championships in Rotterdam, while four other Russian gymnasts receive permission to enter the country
2026 World Artistic Gymnastics Championships

In auto racing, Formula 1 announces a new grand prix in Kigali, Rwanda, to run for at least 10 years starting in the early 2030s with a new track. This would be the first F1 grand prix in Africa since South Africa in 1993
